origin.label: About TODA
origin.headline: By tattoo artists. For tattoo artists.
origin.body1: Dana is a tattoo artist. Tomek watched her come home — exhausted, not from tattooing itself, but from everything around it. Two clients at the same time. Two no-shows. Forty unread messages.
origin.body2: He spent two months building. The result was TODA — a platform built from the real day-to-day of a studio, not from an office.

features.label: Features
features.headline: Everything your studio needs.
features.feature1Excerpt: No more back-and-forth. Your client fills out a structured form once — motif, placement, references, contact details. You immediately see everything you need to give a price estimate.
features.feature2Excerpt: You set your working hours. Your client picks a free slot themselves. Double bookings are structurally impossible — no paper calendar, no chaos.
features.feature3Excerpt: Gallery, about section, booking form — all in one link. Whether Instagram, WhatsApp, or Facebook: always the same link, always the same structured result.

manifest.label: Why TODA
manifest.headline: You should be tattooing. Not managing.
manifest.body: You are an artist. Not an accountant, not a secretary, not customer service all in one. TODA takes care of everything else — so you can focus on what you chose this profession for.

testimonials.label: Voices from the community
testimonials.headline: What other studios say.
testimonials.quote1: My requests come in organised now. No WhatsApp chaos, no missing references. I know immediately whether a request is worth taking.
testimonials.quote2: I used to spend whole evenings just on messages. Now I check in once and I'm done.
testimonials.quote3: Clients already know what to expect before the first conversation. It saves more time than I thought.

caseStudy.label: From the field
caseStudy.statement: 30 years self-employed. 60-hour weeks. What helped her? Less chaos.
caseStudy.quote1: What bothers me most about this profession is client communication.
caseStudy.quote2: Of all times, now that I have exactly this problem, someone comes around the corner with the solution.

footer.tagline: The complete solution for professional tattoo studios.
